__inputs.name: DS_A2VM
__inputs.label: Base de restitution A2VM
__inputs.description: Source de données PostgreSQL de la base de restitution

list.name: tenant
list.label: Client
list.query: SELECT tenant AS __value, tenant_name AS __text FROM a2vm.latest_runs ORDER BY tenant_name
list.definition: SELECT tenant AS __value, tenant_name AS __text FROM a2vm.latest_runs ORDER BY tenant_name

panels.title: Ouvertes avec une priorité
panels.description: Décisions du dernier run dans une priorité du SLA du client.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM a2vm.decision_facts f WHERE f.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM a2vm.latest_runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND f.priority IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Échéance SLA dépassée
panels.description: Décisions du dernier run dont l'échéance de leur priorité est dépassée.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM a2vm.decision_facts f WHERE f.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM a2vm.latest_runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND f.sla_status = 'overdue'

panels.title: Échéance SLA sous 7 jours
panels.description: Décisions du dernier run dont l'échéance SLA tombe dans les 7 prochains jours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM a2vm.decision_facts f WHERE f.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM a2vm.latest_runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND f.sla_due BETWEEN f.day AND f.day + 7

panels.title: Corrigés dans le SLA
panels.description: Part des constats avec une priorité corrigés au plus tard à leur échéance SLA (période du tableau de bord).

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN within_sla THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM a2vm.finding_closures WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(closed_at) AND outcome = 'fixed' AND within_sla IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Mêmes constats dans la BOD 26-04
panels.description: Les mêmes constats rapportés à leur échéance BOD 26-04, pour comparaison.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN within_due THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM a2vm.finding_closures WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(closed_at) AND outcome = 'fixed' AND within_sla IS NOT NULL AND within_due IS NOT NULL

panels.title: ACT et ATTEND sans priorité
panels.description: Décisions à corriger qu'aucune règle du SLA du client ne classe : leur échéance BOD 26-04 s'applique.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM a2vm.decision_facts f WHERE f.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM a2vm.latest_runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND f.priority IS NULL AND f.level IN ('ACT', 'ATTEND') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM a2vm.runs x WHERE x.run_id = f.run_id AND x.sla_overdue IS NOT NULL)

panels.title: Par priorité
panels.description: Par priorité : décisions ouvertes du dernier run, échéance SLA dépassée, échéance sous 7 jours ; constats corrigés dans la période, la part corrigée à temps et le nombre moyen de jours depuis la première observation.

targets.rawSql:
WITH o AS (SELECT f.priority, min(f.priority_rank) AS rk, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.sla_status = 'overdue') AS late, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.sla_due BETWEEN f.day AND f.day + 7) AS soon FROM a2vm.decision_facts f WHERE f.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM a2vm.latest_runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND f.priority IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.priority),
c AS (SELECT priority, min(priority_rank) AS rk, count(*) AS n, round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN within_sla THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS pct, round(avg(days_open), 1) AS d FROM a2vm.finding_closures WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(closed_at) AND outcome = 'fixed' AND priority IS NOT NULL GROUP BY priority)
SELECT priority AS "Priorité", coalesce(o.n, 0) AS "Ouvertes", coalesce(o.late, 0) AS "En retard", coalesce(o.soon, 0) AS "Échéance sous 7 jours", coalesce(c.n, 0) AS "Corrigés", c.pct AS "Corrigés dans le SLA (%)", c.d AS "Jours (moyenne)"
FROM o FULL JOIN c USING (priority) ORDER BY coalesce(o.rk, c.rk), priority

panels.title: Échéance SLA dépassée par jour
panels.description: Dernier run de chaque jour : décisions dont l'échéance SLA est dépassée, et échéance sous 7 jours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT x.generated_at::date::timestamptz AS time, sum(x.sla_overdue) AS "En retard", sum(x.sla_due_soon) AS "Échéance sous 7 jours" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (tenant, generated_at::date) run_id FROM a2vm.runs
  WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(generated_at)
  ORDER BY tenant, generated_at::date, generated_at DESC) r JOIN a2vm.runs x USING (run_id) WHERE x.sla_overdue IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Décisions en retard
panels.description: Décisions du dernier run dont l'échéance SLA est dépassée, la plus ancienne échéance d'abord.

targets.rawSql: SELECT f.asset_name AS "Actif", f.cve AS "CVE", f.level AS "Niveau", f.priority AS "Priorité", f.sla_due AS "Échéance SLA", (f.day - f.sla_due) AS "Jours de retard", f.sla_since AS "Dans la priorité depuis", f.due_date AS "Échéance BOD 26-04", f.kev_label AS "KEV", f.title AS "Description" FROM a2vm.decision_facts f WHERE f.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM a2vm.latest_runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND f.sla_status = 'overdue' ORDER BY f.sla_due, f.priority_rank, f.level_rank, f.cve LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Échéance sous 7 jours
panels.description: Décisions du dernier run dont l'échéance SLA tombe dans les 7 prochains jours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT f.asset_name AS "Actif", f.cve AS "CVE", f.level AS "Niveau", f.priority AS "Priorité", f.sla_due AS "Échéance SLA", f.due_date AS "Échéance BOD 26-04", f.kev_label AS "KEV", f.title AS "Description" FROM a2vm.decision_facts f WHERE f.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM a2vm.latest_runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND f.sla_due BETWEEN f.day AND f.day + 7 ORDER BY f.sla_due, f.priority_rank, f.level_rank, f.cve LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Corrections face au SLA, à leur date réelle
panels.description: Constats corrigés dans la période, face à leur échéance (SLA, sinon BOD 26-04), selon la date réelle de la correction : entre le dernier scan qui voyait encore la faille et le premier qui ne la voyait plus. Met (observed) : ce scan est dans les temps ; missed : la faille était encore vue après l'échéance ; met (declared, verified) : la date déclarée dans l'ITSM tombe dans cet intervalle et dans les temps (après : missed) ; to verify : aucun de ces cas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT fix_status AS "Statut", count(*) AS "Constats" FROM a2vm.finding_closures WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(closed_at) AND outcome = 'fixed' AND fix_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fix_status ORDER BY CASE fix_status WHEN 'met (observed)' THEN 1 WHEN 'met (declared, verified)' THEN 2 WHEN 'to verify' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

panels.title: Corrections hors délai ou à vérifier
panels.description: Les corrections de la période hors délai, ou dont l'intervalle chevauche l'échéance sans date déclarée pour les situer : les scans avant et après, et la date déclarée dans l'ITSM.

targets.rawSql: SELECT asset_name AS "Actif", cve AS "CVE", priority AS "Priorité", fix_status AS "Statut", deadline AS "Échéance retenue", last_vulnerable AS "Vu vulnérable pour la dernière fois", first_clean AS "Premier scan sans la faille", declared_at AS "Déclaré dans l'ITSM" FROM a2vm.finding_closures WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(closed_at) AND outcome = 'fixed' AND fix_status IN ('missed', 'to verify') ORDER BY deadline, asset_name, cve LIMIT 1000
